sample.question_description: Predict the laser result after following reflections.
sample.question_preview: Follow the laser from its start. What is the first terminal result of the beam? Options: [1] exit [2] block [3] target A [4] loop [5] target B [6] target C
sample.question:
Follow the laser from its start. What is the first terminal result of the beam?
Options:
[1] exit
[2] block
[3] target A
[4] loop
[5] target B
[6] target C
sample.analysis:
Cell (6, 1): absorbed by block.
The terminal result is block. Therefore choose option 2.

state_content.rules: A laser starts outside the grid and travels cell by cell. '/' and '\' mirrors reflect it; stone blocks absorb it; targets are hit when the beam enters their cell.
